# classroom-mcp (Classroom + Gmail, headless fork)

> Read-only MCP server for a student's Google Classroom (courses, upcoming assignments with submission status, coursework, announcements, materials) and Gmail (search, read message, read thread, labels). Single Python file, no dependencies. Credentials via GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN; sign in once with `classroom-mcp login`. Fork of Mattlo0546/classroom-mcp. MIT.
